narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Four ones and six hundredths is four point six.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But four point six has the six in the tenths place, and that is six tenths.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The empty tenths place needs a zero to push the six along.
